metadata.description: Primitives in the hydra.core.lib.literals module.
comments: Conversion and parse/print for literal values.

The numeric conversion primitives (bigintToInt32, float64ToFloat32, ...) convert between Hydra's literal numeric types; lossless conversions are exact, and each lossy conversion states its truncation or rounding behavior in its own documentation.
The parseX primitives are pure conversions from text to values, with an optional codomain wherever parsing can fail; the printX primitives are the pure conversions back from values to text.

metadata.description: Decode a base64 ASCII string to binary data.
comments: base64ToBinary(s) decodes the standard base64 (RFC 4648) ASCII string s and returns the resulting bytes as binary data.
Inverse of binaryToBase64: base64ToBinary(binaryToBase64(b)) is b for every binary value. Behavior on strings which are not valid base64 is host-defined.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.base64ToBinary.decodesStandardBase64
provisions.statement: base64ToBinary decodes a standard base64 (RFC 4648) ASCII string to the binary data it represents, including the empty string decoding to empty binary data.

metadata.description: Convert a bigint to a decimal.
comments: bigintToDecimal(x) returns the exact decimal representation of x. Since decimal is arbitrary-precision and bigint is also arbitrary-precision, the conversion is lossless.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.bigintToDecimal.losslessConversion
provisions.statement: bigintToDecimal returns the exact decimal representation of a bigint, with no precision loss, for positive, negative, and zero values.

metadata.description: Convert a bigint to an int16 (truncating).
comments: bigintToInt16(x) returns x reduced modulo 2^16 and reinterpreted as a signed two's-complement int16. Values outside [-2^15, 2^15-1] wrap silently with no exception.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.bigintToInt16.convertsInRange
provisions.statement: bigintToInt16 returns the int16 with the same numeric value as the bigint, for positive and negative values within the int16 range.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.bigintToInt16.wrapsTwosComplementOutOfRange
provisions.statement: bigintToInt16 on a value outside the int16 range ([-2^15, 2^15-1]) wraps silently to the corresponding two's-complement int16, with no exception, at both the positive and negative (all-bits-set) boundary.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.bigintToInt32.wrapsTwosComplementOutOfRange
provisions.statement: bigintToInt32 on a value outside the int32 range ([-2^31, 2^31-1]) wraps silently to the corresponding two's-complement int32, with no exception, at both the positive and negative (all-bits-set) boundary; this holds even on hosts where int32 is represented as a wider native integer, which must not skip the narrowing step.

metadata.description: Encode binary data as a base64 ASCII string.
comments: binaryToBase64(b) encodes the bytes of b using standard base64 (RFC 4648) and returns the result as an ASCII string.

Total and round-trippable: base64ToBinary(binaryToBase64(b)) is b for every binary value. Use this to embed arbitrary binary data in a string context (e.g. a JSON value). For interpreting bytes as text, use hydra.core.lib.text.decodeUtf8 instead.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.binaryToBase64.encodesStandardBase64
provisions.statement: binaryToBase64 encodes binary data as a standard base64 (RFC 4648) ASCII string, including empty binary data encoding to the empty string.

metadata.description: Convert binary data to a list of byte values.
comments: binaryToBytes(b) returns the bytes of b as an int32 list with values in [0, 255], preserving byte order.
The result list element type is int32 rather than uint8 because Hydra's primitive collections work most naturally with int32 indices.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.binaryToBytes.returnsUnsignedByteValues
provisions.statement: binaryToBytes returns the bytes of the binary data as a list of int32 values in [0, 255], preserving byte order, including byte values above 127 (which remain unsigned, not reinterpreted as negative), and the empty list for empty binary data.

metadata.description: Convert a decimal to a bigint (truncating).
comments: decimalToBigint(x) returns x truncated toward zero. Fractional parts are discarded.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.decimalToBigint.convertsWholeNumbers
provisions.statement: decimalToBigint returns the bigint with the same numeric value as a whole-number decimal, for positive, negative, and zero values.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.decimalToBigint.truncatesFractionTowardZero
provisions.statement: decimalToBigint on a decimal with a fractional part discards the fraction, truncating toward zero (rounding down for positive values, up for negative values), not rounding to nearest.

metadata.description: Convert a decimal to a float32.
comments: decimalToFloat32(x) returns the IEEE 754 binary32 value closest to x under roundTiesToEven. Values outside the float32 representable range overflow to ±∞. Subnormal precision loss is silent.

provisions.statement: decimalToFloat32 returns the float32 value with the same numeric value as a decimal that is exactly representable in binary32, for zero and whole-number values.

metadata.description: Convert a float32 to a decimal.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.float32ToDecimal.convertsExactlyRepresentableValues
provisions.statement: float32ToDecimal returns the exact decimal representation of a binary32 value, for zero and whole-number values.

metadata.description: Parse a string as a bigint.
comments: parseBigint(s) returns Just(x) where x is the bigint parsed from s, or Nothing if s is not a valid bigint literal.

Accepted syntax follows the Haskell Show/Read convention: an optional leading minus sign followed by a sequence of decimal digits. Whitespace is not stripped; leading or trailing whitespace causes parse failure.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseBigint.parsesValidLiterals
provisions.statement: parseBigint returns the bigint parsed from a valid bigint literal, wrapped, for positive, negative, zero, and arbitrarily large values.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseBigint.noneOnInvalidInput
provisions.statement: parseBigint returns none when the string is not a valid bigint literal.

metadata.description: Parse a string as a boolean.
comments: parseBoolean(s) returns Just(true) for "true", Just(false) for "false", and Nothing for any other input (including "True"/"False" with capital initial letter on some hosts; behavior on capitalized forms is host-defined and should not be relied upon).

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseBoolean.parsesExactLowercaseLiterals
provisions.statement: parseBoolean returns the wrapped boolean true for the exact string "true" and false for "false".

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseBoolean.noneOnInvalidInput
provisions.statement: parseBoolean returns none for any string other than the exact lowercase literals "true" or "false".

metadata.description: Parse a string as a decimal.
comments: parseDecimal(s) returns Just(x) where x is the decimal parsed from s, or Nothing on parse failure.
Accepted syntax is the standard decimal literal: an optional sign, an integer part, an optional fractional part, and an optional exponent (e.g. -1.5, 2e10, 0.0).

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseDecimal.parsesValidLiterals
provisions.statement: parseDecimal returns the decimal parsed from a valid decimal literal, wrapped, for positive, negative, and zero values.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseDecimal.noneOnInvalidInput
provisions.statement: parseDecimal returns none when the string is not a valid decimal literal.

metadata.description: Parse a string as a float32.
comments: parseFloat32(s) returns Just(x) where x is the IEEE 754 binary32 value closest to the number parsed from s under roundTiesToEven, or Nothing on parse failure.
Accepted special-value literals ("NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity", etc.) and their capitalization are host-defined.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseFloat32.parsesValidLiterals

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseFloat32.noneOnInvalidInput
provisions.statement: parseFloat32 returns none when the string is not a valid float literal.

metadata.description: Parse a string-literal token to a plain string (Just) or Nothing on parse failure.
comments: parseString(s) parses s as a Haskell-syntax string literal token: an opening double-quote, escaped characters per the Haskell lexical grammar (backslash escapes for special characters and Unicode code points), and a closing double-quote. Returns Just of the decoded payload on success or Nothing on malformed input.

provisions.statement: parseString returns the decoded payload of a double-quoted string literal, wrapped.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.parseString.noneOnUnquotedInput
provisions.statement: parseString returns none when the string is not a well-formed double-quoted string literal (for example, an unquoted bare string).

metadata.description: Render a bigint as a string.
comments: printBigint(x) returns the canonical decimal representation of x: an optional leading minus sign followed by decimal digits. No leading zeros are produced (except for the value 0 itself, which renders as "0").

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.printBigint.rendersCanonicalDecimal
provisions.statement: printBigint renders a bigint as its canonical decimal string, with a leading minus sign for negative values and no leading sign for positive values or zero.

metadata.description: Render a boolean as a string.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.printBoolean.rendersLowercaseLiterals
provisions.statement: printBoolean renders true as the exact string "true" and false as "false".

metadata.description: Render a decimal as a string.
comments: printDecimal(x) returns the canonical decimal representation of x as a string. The exact form (use of scientific notation, trailing zeros, etc.) is host-defined but always round-trips with parseDecimal.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.printDecimal.rendersCanonicalDecimal
provisions.statement: printDecimal renders a decimal as a string, for positive and negative whole and fractional values, that always round-trips through parseDecimal back to the original value.

metadata.description: Render a float32 as a string.
comments: printFloat32(x) returns a string representation of x. Finite values use the shortest decimal that round-trips through parseFloat32 back to x. Special values render as "NaN", "Infinity", or "-Infinity" (capitalization is host-defined).

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.printFloat32.rendersRoundTrippableRepresentation
provisions.statement: printFloat32 renders a float32 as a string, for positive, negative, zero, and small-magnitude values, that round-trips through parseFloat32 back to the original value.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.uint64ToBigint.losslessConversion
provisions.statement: uint64ToBigint returns the bigint with the same numeric value as the uint64, with no precision loss, for zero and typical in-range values.

metadata.description: Convert a uint8 to a bigint.
comments: uint8ToBigint(x) returns the bigint with the same numeric value as x. The conversion is exact and lossless.

provisions.name: hydra.core.lib.literals.uint8ToBigint.losslessConversion
provisions.statement: uint8ToBigint returns the bigint with the same numeric value as the uint8, with no precision loss, for zero and the maximum representable value (255).
